title: A group turns like anything else
goal: You can turn a rectangle by dragging the knob above it or by typing an angle, but a group of shapes cannot be turned at all: no knob appears over it, and the panel shows a dash where the angle would be. Anyone laying out a card, a badge or a nav bar and wanting the whole thing on a slant has to turn every piece by hand and line them up again.
notes: Today Sources/Photonz/CanvasGroups.swift:82 offersRotation returns false for any group (isGroup), and LayerGeometryEditing sets turnsAtAll false for the same reason, so the A field renders a dash with LayerGeometryEditing.groupTurnReason behind it. Renderer side: check DocumentRenderer composites a group transform before promising this. Written 2026-09-09 while landing the angle field; the angle field task deliberately left this alone and asked for it to be filed.
acceptance: A group offers the rotate knob on the canvas, and dragging it turns the group and everything inside it as one
The Position and Size section shows the group angle as a number you can read and type, instead of the dash it shows now
Turning a group is one undo step, and the pieces inside keep their own angles relative to it
Anything drawn on top of a group (the outline, the handles, the name label) sits where the turned group is, not where its unturned box was
